title: N55: MCS test added to paper — GJR superior, GARCH eliminated (p=0.044)
description: Ran Model Confidence Set (Hansen, Lunde, Nason 2011) with 10000 bootstrap replications for SPY 2023-2024. MCS superior set at 10%: {GJR-N, GJR-t, GJR-GED}. GARCH-N and GARCH-t eliminated with p=0.044. Added to Section 4.3.3 and methodology Section 3.4.2. This provides formal multi-model evidence beyond pairwise DM tests.
